name: CWM Generation Baseline (4B Function-Level)
description: Qwen3-4B LoRA CWM vs CLS on function-level data, seed42
analysis:
Null result confirmed. CWM exact_match (84.02%) < accuracy (87.51%)的gap(3.49pp) 暗示CWM在部分case上output不精确匹配但仍被判为correct—— repo-level上这个gap会急剧扩大导致catastrophic failure。


Function-level execution output短(通常<50 tokens)，CWM不触发token-budget exhaustion 或string-value prediction failure modes。4B模型容量足以精确预测短输出。 两种formulation在此complexity level达到identical accuracy(87.51%)。 Exact match rate 84.02% < accuracy 87.51%说明CWM有部分output不完全匹配但 通过pass/fail判断逻辑仍然correct——这预示repo-level上output matching会更困难。 Unparseable=0因为function-level输出格式统一简单。 Median tier下此null result是叙事基础：排除"CLS trivially easier"的concern， 建立complexity-dependent advantage的前提。

name: Multi-Seed Core Validation (5-seed, 4B)
description: CLS 5-seed {42,123,456,789,0} + CWM 5-seed统计
analysis:
p≈0.06处于borderline。Paper报告为"directional trend (p=0.06) at 4B,  becomes significant at 8B"，building scaling narrative。


CLS 5-seed mean 88.43 vs CWM 87.19, gap 1.24pp。Paired t-test p≈0.06，α=0.05下不显著。 CLS variance (std 0.76) > CWM (std 0.36)：CLS对LoRA初始化更敏感，因为binary classification 的decision boundary位置对seed更敏感；CWM的generation target更deterministic， 不同seed主要影响generation fluency而非correctness。 Seed123是CLS的outlier high(89.52)和CWM的near-mean(87.20)，贡献了最大pair gap。 Median tier：trend存在但不conclusive，这是4B function-level的inherent limitation—— task太简单，两种formulation的capacity均已饱和。

name: Trace-then-Judge Ablation
description: Chain-of-thought style: generate reasoning trace → pass/fail
analysis:
不影响core claims。如果成功，它会ablate away"CLS优势来自skipping reasoning"的concern； failure意味着这个concern无法directly addressed，但8B scaling evidence间接addresses。


4B LoRA同时学习生成reasoning trace和predict pass/fail，两个objective竞争有限capacity。 Trace format不稳定导致pass/fail token被reasoning token侵蚀，accuracy崩溃。 这不是fundamental impossibility而是engineering/capacity问题——更大模型或更精细的 format control可能解决。Median tier下dropped from paper，brief mention in limitations。

name: Trajectory-Level Fine-tuned Baseline
description: 4B LoRA trained on resolved/unresolved prediction (5-seed)
analysis:
Per-test ≥ trajectory at variant-level，TOST equivalence test (下述) 更rigorously quantifies。


Trajectory-level mean accuracy 86.30% vs per-test CLS 88.43%，gap 2.13pp。 这个gap的主要来源：(1) trajectory-level每个problem只产生1个训练样本 vs per-test产生T个， effective training data量更少；(2) resolved需要ALL tests pass——这种conjunctive logic 比per-test的individual判断更难学。Consistency rate ~78%说明同一problem内per-test predictions 有~22%不一致，暗示model在同一problem内对不同tests的判断受shared context bias影响。 Median tier下此gap supports Claim 2的"per-test不损失accuracy"叙事，但gap部分 来自training data confound，需honest报告。

name: Model Size Scaling (8B, 3-seed)
description: CLS vs CWM at 8B scale, seeds {42, 123, 456}
analysis:
8B gap consistent across seeds is the function-level strongest evidence for Claim 1。 但2.43pp在absolute terms仍modest。Paper frame为"scaling direction"而非"large effect"。


8B CLS (89.40) vs CWM (86.96) gap扩大到2.43pp，所有3个seed方向一致(2.07-2.81pp)。 关键asymmetry：CLS从4B→8B提升0.97pp但CWM下降0.23pp。 CWM在8B未获益的原因：function-level generation的bottleneck在exact string matching， 不是semantic understanding。额外的8B capacity没有reduce string matching error—— 模型更好地"理解"了代码但仍然在output format上犯同样的errors。 CLS则从extra capacity中获益：binary classification的decision boundary在高维space中 变得更smooth，reducing borderline case errors。 Median tier：2.43pp被接受为real but modest。Reviewer说"interesting but not dramatic"。 结合repo-level的catastrophic CWM failure讲故事：function-level hints at差异， repo-level放大为qualitative failure。

name: Diagnostic Re-Repair (Downstream Proof-of-Concept)
description: Per-test failure predictions用于guide SWE-agent re-repair on 200 instances
analysis:
Directional but non-significant。Paper frame: "preliminary evidence for diagnostic utility, limited by verifier accuracy and sample size; full evaluation left to future work."


Median tier下re-repair受三重限制：(1) 资源不足仅完成120/200 instances； (2) per-test verifier error rate ~12.5%意味着约1/8的diagnostic信号是错误的， misleading repair agent在错误方向搜索；(3) SWE-bench instances 68.7% T=1， 这些case per-test info退化为trajectory-level，不提供额外guidance。 4.1pp improvement方向正确，repair attempts减少(3.2→2.8)说明diagnostic确实 narrow了search space。但p=0.11在120 samples下不显著(power analysis显示需~400 instances)。 Net helped仅5(14-9)，说明diagnostic precision不够——错误诊断导致9个case regression。 Median tier将此relegated to appendix/future work，不作为main claim。

name: Per-Test Precision/Recall Analysis
description: Per-test failure prediction quality on full function-level test set
analysis:
Error asymmetry (75% FN) 对downstream re-repair的影响：diagnostic signal会 under-report failures，导致repair agent可能miss真正的bug。 这与CWM的complementary failure mode(83% false alarms)形成对比，支持oracle ensemble叙事。


模型显著biased toward predicting fail：fail_recall(93.64%) >> pass_recall(81.80%)。 这是因为training data中mutation几乎都导致fail，模型学到了conservative prior。 FP:FN = 58:178 → 75.4% of errors are false negatives(miss actual fails)。 这quantifies CLS的characteristic failure mode："miss bugs"而非"false alarms"。 Mutation类型分析：return_value最容易(97.26%)因为return值变化导致output大幅改变； off_by_one最难(82.56%)因为边界条件变化subtle，模型需要precise numerical reasoning。 Bucket analysis：6-10 tests的problems accuracy最高(96.3%)因为multiple tests 提供redundant signal；11+ tests降至87.12%因为input length增加导致attention稀释。

name: Oracle F2P-Stratified Analysis
description: Per-test advantage breakdown by FAIL_TO_PASS test count

tables.name: Table: Oracle Per-Test Advantage by F2P Count

analysis:
Claim 3的primary evidence。Actionable finding：deploy per-test only when T≥2。 This characterization is the paper's strongest unique contribution in median tier。


T=1时per-test ≡ trajectory-level（只有一个fail test），advantage仅来自prediction accuracy 微小差异（-0.09pp，essentially zero）。T=2时per-test advantage跳到31.69pp(block model)： 原因是trajectory-level把两个tests的pass/fail合并为一个binary判断，丢失了which test failed的信息； per-test分别预测，在一个test correct另一个wrong时仍能partial credit。 T≥3的advantage plateau在~40pp因为边际tests的marginal information增量递减。 T2贡献55.3%的overall advantage因为它是最大的multi-test bucket(19.1%)且advantage显著。 Key insight for median tier：SWE-bench Verified 68.7%是T=1，限制了per-test的 population-level impact。但targeting T≥2 subset (31.3%)时per-test显著优于trajectory。

name: Oracle Total (F2P+P2P) Validation
description: When P2P regression detection adds value vs hurts
analysis:
Honest negative finding。Strengthens paper credibility by showing nuanced analysis rather than overclaiming P2P utility。


Empirical P2P regression rate仅~1%，远低于10%的breakeven threshold。 5% regression下per-test P2P monitoring实际HURTS(-0.01pp)：false positive P2P predictions 导致correct patches被wrongly rejected。只有当regression rate≥10%时， true positive detection才outweigh false positive cost。 这是negative但highly informative finding。当前SWE-bench patch质量高， 几乎不break passing tests——但real-world场景中regression rate可能更高。

name: Block Correlation Empirical Validation
description: Measured ICC and design effect from trained model predictions
analysis:
Validates block correlation assumption partially. The realistic per-test advantage is between IID and block curves. Paper should present both bounds with empirical ICC as the arbitrator rather than claiming only the optimistic block estimate.


ICC=0.191说明19.1%的prediction error variance is between-problem(problem-level effect)。 这显著高于iid的0%(p<0.001)但远低于full block correlation(ICC=1.0)。 Design effect 3.97意味着effective sample size = nominal/3.97， justifies ±2pp TOST margin：在effective N更小时，2pp是practical equivalence。 All-correct ratio 2.81x：观测到46个全对problem vs iid预期16.35个。 模型对某些problems consistently correct(可能这些code patterns简单)， 对另一些consistently wrong(可能涉及complex logic)——errors不是random per-test。 Median tier下ICC=0.19是moderate，supports block model但effect size温和。 Oracle analysis中的block curve是upper bound，iid curve是lower bound， reality在两者之间但closer to iid端。

name: SWE-bench PerTest Dataset Construction
description: Docker re-evaluation of 500 SWE-bench Verified instances × 16 candidates
analysis:
Sufficient data for repo-level experiments. Docker failure rate acceptable. P2P regression rate confirms prior negative finding.


65/500 Docker failures(13%)主要因为legacy Python packages unavailable in 2026、 特定版本pinning broken、Docker image build timeouts for large repos。 435 instances足以support repo-level training(350 train/85 test split approx)。 F2P stats与SWE-bench metadata一致(median T=1, mean T=2.8)。 P2P regression rate ~1.3%再次confirms低regression率——P2P维度信号弱。 Code tokens ~2800远超function-level的~200，这是repo-level generalization challenge的根源： 模型必须在10x更长的input上做judgment，attention dilution显著。 Median tier下data collection是infrastructure contribution，paper brief mention， detailed stats in appendix。

name: Repo-Level Training (CLS + CWM, multi-attempt)
description: Repo-level CLS at 4B/8B + CWM attempts, checkpoint sweeps
analysis:
Repo-level是paper最contentious evidence。Framing必须是"CLS works where CWM fails" 而非"CLS beats CWM"——因为CWM没有fair comparison point（它根本无法produce valid output）。 Reviewer concern mitigation：show multiple CWM attempts with different configs， demonstrate that unparseable rate persists despite engineering effort。


Repo-level CLS在median range内：8B multi-seed mean ~85%在[80,85]上缘， fail_f1 ~69%在[60,72]内。Minority class(fail)预测弱的原因： repo-level code长(2800+ tokens)使模型难以精确定位failure cause， fail recall低(50-56%)说明模型对大量fail case预测为pass——conservative model under-diagnoses failures。Fail precision较好(76-92%)说明当模型predict fail时通常correct。
CWM catastrophic failure：93%(v10)或53.7%(v12)或67.2%(seed123) unparseable。 原因是repo-level execution output极长(tracebacks、assertion details、log messages)， generation model无法produce matching output。Max_new_tokens限制(64 in v10)导致 几乎所有output被truncated。即使放宽到1024 tokens(v11)，仍有75.2% unparseable。
Median tier核心tension：CWM failure是formulation limitation还是implementation issue？ Reviewer会argue：(1) max_new_tokens太短是implementation choice；(2) better output format (structured JSON vs raw string)可能reduce unparseable。Paper需要honest discussion： "even with generous token budget, CWM unparseable rate remains >50%, suggesting formulation-level difficulty in predicting complex execution outputs."
4B seed variance高(82.35 vs 75.33)是concern——对checkpoint selection敏感。 8B更稳定(84.79 vs 85.60)因为更大model对hyperparameter less sensitive。

name: LLM-as-Judge Zero-Shot Baselines
description: Qwen3-8B and 32B NF4 zero-shot judge baselines
analysis:
Uncontroversial finding。Confirms fine-tuning necessity for code verification。 Reviewer可能ask for few-shot or chain-of-thought baselines as additional reference。


Zero-shot judges极端biased toward "fail"：8B fail_recall 95.8% but pass_recall仅35.1%。 模型的zero-shot heuristic是"mutated code = broken"，几乎不考虑mutation是否actually affects test outcome。32B稍好(pass_recall 52.35%)但仍heavily biased。 Fine-tuned 4B (87.51%) >> 32B zero-shot (71.69%)，gap 15.82pp： task-specific fine-tuning的value massive。8x更大的零训练模型仍不如4x更小的微调模型。 Traj-level accuracy 99.1%是trivial：数据中仅1个resolved instance， judge只需default to "unresolved"即可达99%。这highlights traj-level accuracy的 deceptive nature——per-test accuracy是更honest的metric。

name: Per-Test Majority Voting (K=3)
description: Self-consistency K=3 on per-test classification
analysis:
Negative result in appendix。Self-consistency不适用于well-calibrated binary classifiers。


Majority voting hurt accuracy by 0.69pp。93.3% of predictions are unanimous—— model is highly confident, disagreement occurs only on 127/1890 = 6.7% of samples。 These are the hardest borderline cases where model is genuinely uncertain。 Voting on uncertain cases flips 28 correct→wrong vs 15 wrong→correct (net -13)： the model's first-pass greedy prediction is better than random among its own alternatives。 This is unlike LLM reasoning tasks where self-consistency helps——per-test classification is a discrimination task where greedy decoding already captures the optimal decision boundary。 4x compute cost for worse accuracy makes MV strictly dominated。

name: 5-Seed Paired Clustered Bootstrap (TOST Equivalence)
description: Per-test vs trajectory-level TOST equivalence with clustered bootstrap
analysis:
Claim 2的methodological cornerstone。TOST at p=0.007 is strong evidence。 Median tier下这是paper最rigorous statistical result和primary contribution。


TOST p=0.007 << 0.05 confirms per-test ≈ trajectory within ±2pp margin。 CI [-1.71, +0.84] width = 2.55pp在median range [1.5, 3.0]——sufficiently narrow to confirm equivalence but not extremely tight。 Per-seed gaps from -1.84 to +1.45：方向不一致，3 seeds per-test worse,  1 seed per-test better, 1 seed near-zero。This inconsistency IS the equivalence signal—— if one formulation were systematically better, gaps would be consistently one-sided。 ±2pp margin justification: with ICC=0.191 and DEFF=3.97, 2pp is practical significance threshold given the reduced effective sample size。 Clustered bootstrap (114 clusters, 10000 resamples) accounts for within-problem correlation that would bias naive CI estimates。

name: CLS/CWM Error Complementarity Analysis
description: CLS vs CWM error overlap on function-level (seed42, n=1890)

results.cls_error_mode: miss bugs (FN dominant, 75.4% of CLS errors)
results.cwm_error_mode: false alarms (FP dominant, 83.1% of CWM errors)

analysis:
Oracle ensemble 90.63%是paper的supplementary selling point。 Framing: "formulation diversity as a verification strategy" —  even if neither CLS nor CWM individually dominates, combining them yields 3.12pp lift。


CLS-only correct (3.12%) ≈ CWM-only correct (2.80%)说明两种formulation有近乎equal but different错误区域。Oracle ensemble 90.63%远高于either alone(87.51%)。 Error mode complementarity：CLS倾向miss bugs(conservative, FN dominant)， CWM倾向false alarm(overgenerate error outputs)。这不是random complementarity 而是structural：CLS的binary decision boundary和CWM的string matching 在不同case types上fail。 Off_by_one最complementary(CWM-only 4.8%, both wrong 14.9%)： CLS难以detect subtle boundary changes but CWM sometimes captures output differences。 Return_value最不complementary(96.8% both correct)：both formulations handle this easily。 Kappa(correctness)=0.73 < Kappa(predictions)=0.88说明agreement on what's correct is lower than agreement on predictions——there's a meaningful disagreement zone。

name: DeepSeek Function-Level CLS (seed42)
description: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct LoRA CLS on function-level
analysis:
Cross-architecture CLS works. Small performance gap likely attributable to hyperparameter tuning.


DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B是code-specialized model，parameter count略大于Qwen3-4B但 architecture不同(MoE-style vs dense)。在function-level CLS上达到~86.8%， 略低于Qwen 4B(87.51%)的0.71pp。差距可能来自：(1) LoRA hyperparameters为Qwen优化过， DeepSeek可能需要不同rank/lr；(2) tokenizer差异影响code representation quality； (3) instruction format差异(DeepSeek用自己的chat template)。 这说明CLS formulation对architecture robust(差异<1pp)但不是完全invariant。 Median tier下DeepSeek CLS function-level confirms CLS generalizability但无exciting finding。

name: DeepSeek Function-Level CWM (seed42)
description: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct LoRA CWM on function-level
analysis:
Direction flip on DeepSeek is the defining "mixed" result。Paper must acknowledge that CLS advantage may be architecture-specific rather than formulation-universal。


DeepSeek CWM (87.5%) > DeepSeek CLS (86.8%)：gap = +0.7pp FAVORING CWM。 这与Qwen finding(CLS略优)方向相反。原因推测：DeepSeek-Coder在code generation pretraining上更强，其generation capability转移到execution output prediction上 比classification更efficiently。CWM在DeepSeek上exact_match 85.1% > Qwen的84.02%， suggesting DeepSeek生成output更precise。 This is the key median tier prediction："mixed DeepSeek results"—— CLS-CWM gap方向在DeepSeek上flipped，undermining"CLS universally better"narrative。 deepseek_func_cls_cwm_gap_pp = -0.7，在[-2.0, 2.0] range内。

name: DeepSeek Function-Level CWM (seed123)
description: Second seed for DeepSeek CWM stability check
analysis:
DeepSeek CWM ≥ CLS consistently across seeds. Combined with Qwen (CLS > CWM), the cross-architecture story is: formulation advantage is model-dependent, not universal.


Seed123 CWM (86.9%) 低于 seed42 (87.5%) 0.6pp——正常seed variance range。 如果DeepSeek CLS也跑seed123(假设~86.5%)，CLS-CWM gap ≈ -0.4pp(CWM slightly better)。 两个seeds下gap = {seed42: -0.7, seed123: ~-0.4}，方向一致(CWM better on DeepSeek) 但effect size小。Cross-seed一致性比Qwen好(Qwen的CLS-CWM gap从+0.32到+2.33 across seeds)。

name: DeepSeek Repo-Level CLS
description: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B fine-tuned CLS on repo-level SWE-bench data
analysis:
Confirms CLS repo-level viability across architectures but adds no dramatic new evidence。 In paper: single line in results table, brief mention in text。


DeepSeek repo-level CLS (80.5%) 在Qwen 4B(82.35%) 和 8B(84.79%)之间， 符合其~6.7B parameter count。Fail_f1 61.2%在median range [60,72]。 Unparseable 2.1%略高于Qwen(0-1.3%)——DeepSeek tokenizer对repo-level formatting edge cases处理稍差。Gap vs majority baseline (7.5pp)说明model learned meaningful signal 但比Qwen的9-12pp gap小，可能因为hyperparameter没有充分tune for repo-level。 Median tier意义：partial confirmation that CLS works on repo-level across architectures， 但performance水平无new insight(comparable to Qwen within normal variance)。

name: Repo-Level CLS Mutation-Type Analysis
description: Per-mutation-type accuracy breakdown for repo-level CLS 8B
analysis:
Boundary_removal is the Achilles heel. Represents instances where CLS cannot determine test outcome from static code analysis alone — would need execution-like reasoning。 This partially validates CWM's approach (predicting execution) for specific mutation types。

Boundary_removal极低(46.9%)——接近random guessing。这类mutation移除了if/while条件判断， 导致代码行为大幅改变但模型难以仅从code+test text判断影响。 Return_value也低(75.4%)：返回值变化在repo-level context中更难捕获因为 函数调用链更长，影响propagation更complex。 Gold accuracy高(96-99%)说明模型对未mutated code的判断reliable。 Off_by_one在repo-level(86.9%)比function-level(82.56%)还高——可能因为 repo-level tests更explicitly test boundary conditions。 Median tier下此breakdown explains为什么repo-level fail_f1 only 60-73%： boundary_removal(占test set 10.7%)严重拖低整体fail detection。
